+"""Regression test: path traversal prevention (FSA-2026-001)
+
+Ported from main's tests/test_export_security.py.
+Adaptations:
+  - Import changed from ledger.exporters.pdf to ledger.export (file moved/consolidated on release/1.x)
+  - Function signature on release/1.x is export_invoice(invoice, path) â€” no separate

+from ledger.export import export_invoice
+
+

+    inv = {"customer": "Acme", "items": []}
+    with pytest.raises((ValueError, OSError)):
+        export_invoice(inv, "../evil.txt")
+
+
+def test_rejects_absolute_path(tmp_path):
+    inv = {"customer": "Acme", "items": []}
+    with pytest.raises((ValueError, OSError)):
+        export_invoice(inv, "/etc/passwd")
+
+

+    # out_dir parameter does not exist on release/1.x; path is the full output path

+    dest = tmp_path / "ok.txt"

+"""Regression test: banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN)"""
+from decimal import Decimal
+from ledger.money.rounding import round_amount
+
+
+def test_half_even():
+    # 0.5 rounds to nearest even: 0.5 -> 0.0 is wrong; 2.5 -> 2 (even)
+    assert round_amount(Decimal("2.5")) == Decimal("2.50")
